node: Vertical AI automation software, proprietary data platforms, implementation services, compliance workflows, and industrial/defense AI systems
summary: Expanded the universe for the vertical AI automation/data-integration node with a two-lane structure: Palantir as the reference leader, plus three smaller US-listed candidates where AI exposure may be tied to domain data, regulated workflows, defense/security deployment, contact-center automation, or implementation depth.
